verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships a built-in AI assistant, AskFred, described as letting users 'ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts' and take actions like sharing, moving, and creating soundbites from meetings — directly matching task delegation to an in-product AI persona. This is corroborated by pricing page listing 'AskFred: AI assistant' as a feature tier and MCP tool docs showing actionable capabilities (fireflies_share_meeting, fireflies_move_meeting, fireflies_create_soundbite). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating AskFred's real-world task delegation reliability beyond vendor docs.
